title: Catheter Robot Atlas: simulation-to-robot study record
description: One study in which a controller or model trained in simulation ran on a physical catheter or guidewire robot, with its success in simulation and on the robot.

title.description: Paper title from the bibliography; null when not in it.

robot_id.description: The robot record this study ran on, when the robot is in the catalogue.

robot_used.description: The physical robot as the paper describes it.

trained.description: What was trained (policy, perception model) and how.

gap_closing.description: What the study did to close the simulation-to-robot gap.

real_setup.description: Where it ran on hardware (phantom, animal) and how often.

real_success.description: Success on the robot as reported.
